name: Provenance Break — Chain of Custody Collapsed
description: High-quality evidence with strong indicators — but the chain of custody has a missing ancestor. Trust collapses to near-zero. Traditional systems accept this. VIGÍA rejects it.

artifacts.description: SHA-256 of suspicious binary: known malware hash match (VirusTotal: 47/70). BUT: no acquisition record. No chain from disk image to this file.
File creation timestamp matches known C2 beacon interval. Strong indicator — but provenance chain has single orphaned hash, no root.

provenance_analysis.reason: No root of trust. Cannot verify evidence was not modified post-acquisition or planted post-incident.

peirce_chain.firstness: 47/70 VirusTotal detections — looks like strong evidence
peirce_chain.secondness: No acquisition record. No examiner signature. Hash chain has no root.
peirce_chain.thirdness: Evidence integrity cannot be verified. Under Daubert, this is inadmissible.

vigia.reason: Chain of custody broken — trust collapses

demo_quote: This case contains high-quality evidence with strong indicators. However, the chain of custody is broken. VIGÍA collapses trust and rejects the evidence. Traditional systems would accept this. VIGÍA does not.
